answer_text:
Here is a roundup of the **best free online auto repair estimate tools** available:

---

## 🔧 Top Free Online Auto Repair Estimate Sites

---

### 1. 🏆 [RepairPal](https://repairpal.com/estimator)
RepairPal has been the #1 automotive industry estimator since 2008, developed by ASE-certified mechanics. The RepairPal Fair Price Estimator™ is trusted by millions of consumers and over 3,800 RepairPal Certified locations. If the repair cost exceeds the estimate range, they can intervene to work with the shop on your behalf or refund the difference. The shop agrees to honor the RepairPal Price Guarantee for 30 days after the repair is performed — if you're charged a higher price, they will refund you the difference.

---

### 2. 🚗 [Kelley Blue Book (KBB)](https://www.kbb.com/auto-repair/)
KBB offers a free car repair estimator to find out what you should expect to pay for common auto repairs and maintenance. Estimating repair costs using their tool is the best and easiest way to know how much you can expect to pay, based on what others have paid.

---

### 3. 🔩 [YourMechanic](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates)
YourMechanic lets you know the cost of your car repair — fast and free, with over 600,000 car repair estimates provided since 2012. Just fill out the form and get your estimate immediately. YourMechanic's flat-rate pricing is based on the labor time and parts required to fix your car, and their estimates show the full price breakdown so there's never any mystery behind service prices. They offer over 600 repair, maintenance, and diagnostic services backed by a 12-month, 12,000-mile warranty.

---

### 4. 🏪 [NAPA Auto Care Repair Estimator](https://www.napaonline.com/en/auto-care/car-repair-estimator)
The NAPA Auto Care Repair Estimator is a quick and easy way to get price estimates for the most common car repairs and routine maintenance services, tailored to your exact make and model.

---

### 5. 🛡️ [AAA Repair Estimator](https://www.aaa.com/autorepair/estimate)
Whether the job involves routine maintenance or more involved repairs, AAA can provide you with an estimate of the cost, including breakdowns for parts, labor, and the member discount available at their network of facilities. Each of the more than 7,000 auto repair shops in the AAA network undergoes a comprehensive investigation and meets AAA's stringent standards.

---

### 6. 🤖 [Otto (AI-Powered Body Repair)](https://www.ottofixit.com/)
Otto's car damage calculator uses AI to analyze a photo of your car and return a free repair estimate in under 30 seconds — just upload a photo, enter your ZIP, and the calculator estimates your repair cost based on thousands of real shop invoices. Otto can provide estimates for auto body damage including dents, scratches, collision repair, and paint damage.

---

### 7. 🔄 [Openbay](https://app.openbay.com/)
Openbay lets you search your car issue and zip code to get quotes from top-rated auto repair professionals near you, then compare pricing and book your appointment online. Openbay comes at no cost with no hidden charges or fees — it's free to register and use.

---

### 8. 🎨 [Maaco Online Estimator](https://www.maaco.com/online-estimator/)
Maaco offers a free online estimate specifically for auto body repair, painting, and collision repair services.

---

### 9. [Caliber Collision](https://www.caliber.com/online-estimate)
Caliber provides a free initial online estimate for auto body and collision repair, auto glass services, and car repair — available through convenient contactless repair estimates online.

---

## 💡 Tips for Getting the Best Repair Estimate:
- **Get multiple estimates** — prices can vary significantly between shops.
- Find out what other repair shops will charge for the same work and weigh the costs carefully.
- If it's a common repair or maintenance item like an oil change, new brakes, or tune-up, you can often find a promotion or coupon.
- The best way to keep your car repair costs low is to keep up with regular maintenance on your vehicle.
